item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=formal+models+of+open-endedness+and+autonomous+task+selection+in+intelligent+systems&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"A survey on LLM-as-a-judge.\", \"abstract\": \"Accurate and consistent evaluation is crucial for decision-making across numerous fields, yet it remains challenging due to inherent subjectivity, variability, and scale. Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success, leading to \\\"LLM-as-a-judge,\\\" where LLMs serve as evaluators for complex tasks. With their ability to process diverse data types and provide scalable assessments, LLMs present a compelling alternative to traditional expert-driven evaluations. However, ensuring the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge systems remains a significant challenge requiring careful design and standardization. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of LLM-as-a-judge, offering a formal definition and detailed classification while addressing the core question of how to build reliable LLM-as-a-judge systems. We explore strategies to enhance reliability, including improving consistency, mitigating biases, and adapting to diverse scenarios. We propose methodologies for evaluating reliability, supported by a novel benchmark. To advance development and deployment, we discuss practical applications, challenges, and future directions. Our contributions span multiple levels: we establish conceptual boundaries, reorganize fragmented literature into a unified framework, and propose a reliability-oriented benchmark. We articulate a forward-looking research agenda, offering theoretical foundations and practical guidance for constructing reliable and trustworthy LLM-as-a-judge systems.\", \"doi\": \"10.1016/j.xinn.2025.101253\", \"pmid\": \"42254963\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13237853\", \"source\": \"MED\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Subscription required\", \"availabilityCode\": \"S\", \"documentStyle\": \"doi\", \"site\": \"DOI\", \"url\": \"https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xinn.2025.101253\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13237853\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open…
